5.title: Hover Effects
5.description: Create a button that changes its background color and adds a box-shadow when hovered. Use the :hover pseudo-class.

testCases.description: Style .btn with background-color: #3498db, color: white, padding: 10px 20px
Style .btn with background-color: #4db, color: white, padding: 10px 20px

5.expectedOutput:
<!DOCTYPE html>
<html>
<head>
    <style>
        .btn {
            background-color: #3498db;
            color: white;
            padding: 10px 20px;
            border: none;
            border-radius: 4px;
            cursor: pointer;
            font-size: 16px;
            transition: all 0.3s ease;
        }
        .btn:hover {
            background-color: #2980b9;
            box-shadow: 0 4px 8px rgba(0,0,0,0.3);
        }
    </style>
</head>
<body>
    <button class="btn">Hover Me</button>
</body>
</html>
5.expectedOutputHint: The button should change appearance when you hover over it — darker background and shadow.

6.title: Status Card Surface: set a specific background color
6.description: Give the lesson card a deep blue surface color. Use background-color rather than the background shorthand so a separately configured background image would remain intact.
6.learningObjective: Use background-color to set a component surface without replacing other background properties.
instructions: Select the lesson card with its class.
Do not replace the background shorthand or change the markup.
Keep the text and card content readable.

workedExample.input: The supplied lesson-card markup and starter stylesheet.
workedExample.output: The reference preview shows the requested grid arrangement.
workedExample.explanation: The background shorthand resets multiple background subproperties. The longhand background-color changes only the color, which is safer when styles are composed from multiple rules.

6.hint: background-color changes the color layer while leaving background-image and other background settings alone.
